title: IRS Enrolled Agent Exam Part 2: Businesses
description: EA Part 2: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
notice: The Special Enrollment Examination (SEE) is an examination of the Internal Revenue Service, administered by PSI Services. This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by the Internal Revenue Service, the U.S. Department of the Treasury or PSI Services. It uses IRS publications, which are works of the U.S. Government. Tax amounts are for tax year 2025.

glossary.EZ: the short version of a form (as in Form 1023-EZ or 990-EZ)
glossary.SS: as in Form SS-8, the request for a worker-status ruling

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 764 cards against the 2025 IRS publications and instructions they quote, word for word as found by the card checker, and worked every scenario's arithmetic and dates step by step
checks.result: 2 wrong cards (a W-2 due date that fell on a Saturday, and a partnership elect-out count that left out the S corporation partner's shareholders) were fixed and rechecked; 2 unsupported claims, 8 ambiguous cards, 5 unclear ones and 97 minor issues (80 of them 2025 figures not yet marked volatile) were also fixed, and 8 duplicates removed.
